description: The person's Selfie itemized within the seven KSA groupings: each statement in plain words, what it came from (their words, a life event, a document passage), its KSA Dictionary connection, their affirmation and their words, supporting evidence, and third-party verification (none is recorded in this POC). Proposed statements are marked as proposed. Beside the groupings: the person's interests in their own words and the possibilities they explored (occupations, certifications, programs, destinations), each with its source, the statements that support it with their affirmation, what prompted it and what it led them to describe. These are part of the person's record, kept distinct from the statements about what they have learned, and none is a qualification.

include_set_aside.description: Also show statements the person rejected or removed

package.description: The package the last GoldSeam Selfie answer returned (goldribbon_package_v1 with its selfie_interview part). Keep it for the person and send it back whole; GoldSeam keeps no copy.

name: show_me_my_selfie

explored_possibilities.description: note, and items: each explored possibility's id, kind, code, title, source, prompted_by, supported_by (every observation's), led_to, and observations: each answer kept with its source, scope (page), captured_at, supported_by and the content it returned; a later capture of the same source and page names the earlier one it refreshes

interests.description: note, and items: each interest's id, the person's words and the possibility it names

limits.description: What this answer could not do, each { code, statement }

package.description: The person's package with the interview; absent when the call could not use it

problem.description: When status is needs_attention: code, statement, what_to_do

status.description: What happened, or needs_attention with a problem

title: Show Me My Selfie
